main_body: snow-covered log cabin with pitched roof and front wall
top_band: snow-covered roof slope in white and pale blue-grey from row 7 to row 35
evidence: Reading down a central column: rows 7-35 show the large pitched snow-covered roof surface (29 rows), terminating at a shaded snow eave lip (rows 32-35) with icicles and dark eave shadow beneath at rows 36-38, followed by the vertical log front wall with inset door and windows from row 36 to row 60 (25 rows).

style.evidence: The snow roof is richly textured with multiple blue-grey and white steps (5 steps) forming scalloped drifts, the log wall has varied brown grain and individual log shading, and outlines use dark browns and dark blue-greys matching adjacent materials rather than flat black.
